title: 1:1 notes
audience: For managers and the people they meet with every week or two.
description: A running 1:1 note. Add topics during the week; after the meeting, tell your AI how it went and it writes it up with the follow-ups.
tagline: Topics, follow-ups and every 1:1 so far.
seoTitle: 1:1 meeting notes template for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
1:1 notes

One running note for your 1:1s with one person. Add topics during the week so nothing waits until you've forgotten it.

## Next time
What to bring up, added during the week.

## Follow-ups
What each of you promised, ticked when done.

## Past 1:1s
Newest first: what you talked about and how they seemed.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "1:1 notes". Read it with fetch before each change. The first time, ask who the 1:1 is with and put their name in the note's first line with edit. During the week, when I mention something to bring up, add it under "Next time" as a bullet. After the 1:1, I'll tell you how it went. Add a section at the start of "Past 1:1s": a "###" heading with their name and the date, what we talked about, and how they seemed. Add anything either of us promised under "Follow-ups" as a checklist line, then remove the topics we covered from "Next time".

asks: Ask who my 1:1 is with and what I want to raise, then add it under Next time.
Emma and I just had our 1:1. She wants to lead the next launch and asked for a mentor.
What did I promise last time?
